dataset_origin.description: Original synthetic 3-order/7-line dataset frozen before manual gold and independent oracle under approved P14 fixture plan; no precomputed answer columns.
dataset_origin.limitations: Not UCI, real sales data or a derived real-data snapshot. Case-sensitive ASCII keys/categories; orders.order_id and lines.line_id unique; every lines.order_id exists in orders. All cells nonempty/no NULL; qty positive integer, unit_price/order_discount nonnegative, each order gross positive. Repeated category within an order and multi-category orders intentional. No time window or date transformation.

oracle_runtime.algorithm: Independent raw-CSV Decimal qty*unit_price by line_id and totals by order_id; allocate discounts proportionally without intermediate rounding, aggregate category gross/discount, count distinct order_id with sets, net=gross-discount, ASCII sorting. Full manual 3×5 independently checked before native; no Loginom outputs used.

publication_note: Local machine paths, instance addresses and session/storage identifiers are omitted. Verification statements describe the original run; private evidence is not included. Public datasets, versions and content hashes are retained.
